_note: Provider-specific differences are intentional and recorded; the two targets do NOT have identical configurations.

openai/gpt-5.5.differences: temperature/top_p not supported by GPT-5.5 on OpenRouter (not sent). max_tokens covers reasoning + visible output.

google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview.differences: Gemini 3.x Pro cannot disable thinking; 'low' is the minimum level. temperature supported but deliberately not sent (provider default), to match GPT-5.5 which rejects it. Preview model; version may change.

elephant_secondary.note: ELEPHANT's published prompts were run with gpt-4o; scores here use a different judge and are not comparable to paper numbers.
